mechanism_claims.claim_text: Sortase-mediated metabolic fluorescent labeling in S. pyogenes supports mode-of-action discrimination for cell-wall-inhibiting antibiotics by tracking growing peptidoglycan phenotype patterns.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: imaging assay and antibiotic reference set in this paper

source_locator.locator: xml:abstract; xml:sec=3:Live monitoring of S. pyogenes cell wall biosynthesis using sortase-mediated metabolic labeling

mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism evidence is for antibiotic mode-of-action assay behavior, not a primary AMP sequence/activity record.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Bacitracin, ramoplanin, and vancomycin produced similar phenotype distributions consistent with depletion or sequestration of peptidoglycan precursor availability under the tested conditions.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: bacitracin, ramoplanin, vancomycin in S. pyogenes JRS4

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=5:Bacitracin and ramoplanin halted cell wall growth; xml:sec=9:Application of cell wall labeling for mechanistic analyses of vancomycin

mechanism_claims.limitations: Ramoplanin sequence/modification is not source-verified as DRAMP18062 in local material.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Flavomycin treatment caused phenotype-D accumulation with multiple septa, supporting a cell-separation inhibition interpretation in living S. pyogenes.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is not an AMP activity/toxicity endpoint.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: D-cycloserine treatment supported excessive peripheral growth and a disrupted transition from peripheral to septal growth; oxacillin produced enlarged cells by a different pattern.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: d-cycloserine and oxacillin in S. pyogenes JRS4

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=7:GAS exhibited enlarged cell size; xml:sec=8:Imaging of peripheral cell wall growth; xml:fig=4:Figure 4; xml:fig=5:Figure 5

mechanism_claims.limitations: Interpretation is specific to the imaging assay and does not supply MIC/toxicity values.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CBPV and Delta-NCBPV produced phenotype-D-prime-enriched patterns distinct from vancomycin, supporting altered glycopeptide mode of action after chlorobiphenyl/lipophilic modification.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: chlorobiphenyl vancomycin and des-N-methylleucyl chlorobiphenyl vancomycin in S. pyogenes JRS4

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=9:Application of cell wall labeling for mechanistic analyses of vancomycin and its semi-synthetic derivatives; xml:fig=7:Figure 7

mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact glycopeptide sequence/modification record is not available as a local DRAMP source snapshot.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Mechanism evidence is paper-specific for antibiotic mode-of-action assay, while AMP sequence/activity support is unrecoverable locally.
